web.description:
# Tripo AI: 3D Model Generator
Unleash your creativity with Tripo AI, an innovative app that harnesses advanced artificial intelligence to transform your images or text prompts into unique, high-quality 3D models.

Tripo AI leverages cutting-edge "text-to-3D" and "image-to-3D" technology to bring your ideas to life.

# Mostly excellent
- I don’t know why this only had a rating of 3 stars. I was tasked with making “action figures” of a coworker and this made it EASY. Use another AI app to make a simplistic image of your subject, then use Image-to-3D to generate a 3D model that can be exported into a file compatible with blender or a 3D printer. The price is steep but I made and exported 4 renderings with the free monthly credits so I feel like I got a very good introduction to the app before needing to pay. Worth trying for any maker.
